title: Polarization on a stochastic-block network
description: 100 agents in two communities with weak inter-edges. A polarizing news article is injected to community A at tick 50; track bimodality.
attribution: Inspired by 2024 stochastic-block polarization studies on social networks.

classes.name: Community A
classes.proseIdentity: A resident of community A. Generally trusts mainstream institutions and has moderate-left priors on policy.

classes.name: Community B
classes.proseIdentity: A resident of community B. Skeptical of institutions, has moderate-right priors, values local autonomy.

payload.text: Breaking: a study claims policy X causes serious harm to families. Many in A are alarmed.
B-leaning sources are saying A is overreacting to a flawed study.

readmeMd:
# Polarization

Two communities loosely connected via a Bridge. Watch the bimodality emerge after the news injection.
